fields.organizationCodeHint: Your organization's short code, for example SHARMA
fields.organizationCodeInvalid: Use 3 to 12 letters or digits, like SHARMA.
fields.usernameInvalid: Use 2 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.noEmailHint: Staff without an email sign in with the organization code. Your admin can reset your password.
signIn.waitSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.intro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code it shows for this account.
twoFactor.backupIntro: Type one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-factor sign-in. Each works once.
twoFactor.trustDevice: Don't ask again on this device for 30 days
twoFactor.trustDeviceHint: Only on a device nobody else uses, never on a shared office computer.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.pendingIntro: Your admin gave you a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
changePassword.intro: Choose a new password. You'll stay signed in here; other devices are signed out.
changePassword.savedNotContinued: Your new password is saved, but the next screen didn't open. Check your connection and continue.

twoFactorSetup.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
twoFactorSetup.pendingIntro: Your organization asks everyone to sign in with a code from an authenticator app as well as a password.
twoFactorSetup.platformIntro: The platform console asks its staff to sign in with a code from an authenticator app as well as a password.
twoFactorSetup.intro: Sign in with a code from an authenticator app as well as your password.
twoFactorSetup.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
twoFactorSetup.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
twoFactorSetup.manualKey: Can't scan it? Type this key instead:
twoFactorSetup.confirmStep: Then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactorSetup.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe; they won't be shown again.
twoFactorSetup.copyFailed: Copying didn't work here. Write the codes down instead.

account.title: Your account
account.name: Name
account.twoFactorRequired: Your organization requires it, so it stays on.
account.turnOffIntro: You'll sign in with your password only. Confirm your password to turn it off.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Type the email you sign in with. If it has an account, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account has that email, a link to reset its password is on its way. It works for one hour.
forgotPassword.noEmail: Staff who sign in with the organization code and a username: ask your admin to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.done: Your password is changed, and you're signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link has expired or was used already.
